sources.document_title: XKB PJ-3582-B 3.5 phone jack drawing (distributor-hosted copy)
sources.locator: Page 1: drawing title block, revisions table, Schematic table (PJ-3582-X), materials table and dimension figures
sources.evidence_extract: Title block: "XKB INDUSTRIAL PRECISION CO.,LIMITED", MODEL TYPE 3.5 PHONE JACK, PART NO. PJ-3582-B, DWG NO. X-PJ-3582-B, page 1/1, revision A1; revisions A0 initial release, A1 2025.06.26. Front view 10.00 x 6.10; barrel D6.00 x 3.00; body length 12.00; PCB holes top view terminals 2 to 6, general tolerance 0.1 mm. Schematic table PJ-3582-X terminals 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 (graphic only). Materials: PBT; terminals 2/3 brass, 4/5/6 phosphor bronze. A5 recorded sha256 64b258ff58fd929e1324d2fe50d81b987af162d086a513d6b5fd70758f922ad6 (2026-11-06) for https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/72f7de7902310f96520199c5d4e56c29.pdf?productCode=C500090; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08): 64b258ff58fd929e1324d2fe50d81b987af162d086a513d6b5fd70758f922ad6, identical. Served by datasheet.lcsc.com, so this is a distributor-hosted mirror of the manufacturer drawing, lower-authority than a manufacturer-hosted copy.
